technology_name: Micronutrient Foliar Formulations for Tuber Crop Management
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
problem_solved: Site-specific micronutrient imbalances affecting tuber crop productivity.
description:
Five micronutrient formulations were developed through soil inventorisation, analysis of soil and plant samples and Site-
Specific Nutrient Management experiments and modeling studies conducted under different situations. They are
i. Cassava in acid soils (Zn, B)
ii. Cassava in neutral to alkaline soils (Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu)
iii. Elephant foot yam (Zn, B, Fe, Mn, Cu)
iv. Yams (Zn, B, Mn, Fe, Cu)
v. Sweet potato (Zn, B)
applications:
Micronutrient fertilizer and specialty plant nutrition manufacturers
Cassava, sweet potato, yam, and elephant foot yam cultivation enterprises
Agricultural input companies and crop advisory service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agricultural cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and sustainable crop productivity programs
